classification_precedence: PASS first, then A/B/C for failing bands
vector_identity: e_total=e_space+e_discrete; verified with 32 eps field-scale tolerance; energy with 128 eps energy-scale tolerance
cross_term_units: Dimensionless squared relative norm; not percent; multiply by 10000 for percent-squared
alignment_zero_policy: N/A if either error norm <=64 eps times reference norm

radial_profile.stability_definition: Report first qualifying point that stays below threshold to center, plus explicitly limited first ten-consecutive-sample window

discrete_bulk_localization.scope: 96 frozen points at z/L=0.4,0.5,0.6 only; association is not causation; cannot diagnose end regions directly
